caption: Latch combines persistent parent expansion choices with selective paths to important descendants.

caption: Latch separates saved presentation intent from live Outliner row interaction and reconciliation.

alt: Latch plugin installed under an Unreal Engine project's Plugins directory
caption: A project installation puts the Latch descriptor and plugin files inside the project's Plugins/Latch folder.
capture_instructions: Capture Windows File Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Latch, with the address bar and Latch.uplugin, Source, Resources and Config visible. Avoid showing a nested double-Latch folder or unrelated plugins.
heading: Project installation

alt: Animation of the first expansion latch, Keep Visible pin and resulting Mixed View
caption: The first-use workflow moves from a normal expander to a red latch and then a pinned descendant exposed through a yellow parent.
capture_instructions: Record a compact Unreal Editor sequence with one folder and children: expand, Alt-click to turn red, unlatch, pin a child using the white pin, collapse the ancestor and show its yellow Mixed triangle. Display mouse modifier labels unobtrusively.
heading: Try Latch on a test hierarchy

alt: Diagram of mouse gestures routed to Latch's input processor and registry
caption: Normal, Alt and Shift expansion interactions take separate paths through Latch and the native Outliner.
capture_instructions: Illustrate a flow from native Outliner expander hit testing through FInputProcessor to normal click, Alt-click ToggleLatch and Shift-click recursive expansion. Show pin clicks separately through SKeepVisiblePin and FRegistry.
heading: Input dispatch

alt: Comparison of normal, latched-open and latched-closed expansion triangles
caption: Grey triangles follow normal Outliner expansion, while red triangles hold their parent's chosen open or closed state.
capture_instructions: Capture three representative parent rows in the same Unreal Outliner: unlocked grey, red latched-expanded with children showing, and red latched-collapsed with children hidden. Include labels naming each state.
heading: Three expansion modes

alt: Animation of Alt-clicking a parent to latch it and attempting ordinary expansion changes
caption: An expansion latch resists normal clicks until Alt-click removes its protected state.
capture_instructions: Record Alt-clicking an expanded parent into red, clicking normally without collapsing it, Alt-clicking again to unlatch, then demonstrating the same interaction on a collapsed parent. Keep the triangle and row text in frame.
heading: What a red latch protects

alt: Diagram of Unlatched, LatchedOpen and LatchedClosed subsystem values
caption: Latch records expansion intent as one of three stored states rather than saving physical tree row visibility.
capture_instructions: Draw the ELatchExpansionState enum as Unlatched, LatchedOpen and LatchedClosed, linked to a saved item key in ULatchSubsystem. Separate the saved state from current STreeView physical expansion.
heading: Stored state

alt: Animation revealing the minimum path to a selected Actor inside collapsed ancestors
caption: Yellow Mixed View exposes only the ancestor rows needed for a selected or pinned descendant, leaving unrelated siblings collapsed.
capture_instructions: Record a deeply nested Actor C beneath Folder/Actor A/Actor B with the ancestors collapsed; select C from the viewport and show the yellow path appearing while unrelated sibling rows remain hidden. Deselect or unpin to show the path reversing.
heading: Why a yellow triangle appears

alt: Animation of clicking a yellow Mixed triangle to commit a normal expansion
caption: Clicking a Mixed ancestor changes the logical branch to fully expanded instead of collapsing the temporary exposure path.
capture_instructions: Start with a yellow ancestor exposing one pinned child. Click its yellow triangle once and show all regular children expanding; the indicator becomes grey if no other Mixed condition remains. Keep the same Outliner framing.
heading: What clicking yellow does

alt: Diagram contrasting a logically collapsed branch with its physically visible Mixed View bridge
caption: Latch preserves logical collapse while temporarily expanding a physical path to a required descendant.
capture_instructions: Draw side-by-side logical hierarchy and physical STreeView representation: collapsed flag false for an ancestor, an exposed required descendant path, suppressed siblings, and FOutlinerRuntime ForcedPhysicalExpansion preserving the original logical value.
heading: Logical/physical split

alt: Comparison of hidden inactive pin slot and enabled white Keep Visible pin
caption: Keep Visible reserves a stable slot beside Actor and Folder labels and keeps enabled pins visible.
capture_instructions: Capture two eligible World Outliner rows: the first with a hovered grey inactive pin in its reserved slot and the second with a white active pin. Show the normal Actor/Folder icons and unchanged label alignment.
heading: Pin a row, not an Actor's render visibility

alt: Diagram of an item identity key persisting while its hierarchy position changes
caption: A Keep Visible key belongs to an Actor or Folder identity, not the row's current screen position.
capture_instructions: Diagram the same Actor GUID/world package identity moving from Folder A to Folder B while its KeepVisible key remains in ULatchSubsystem. Show the Outliner row being recreated without changing the pin's logical state.
heading: Data ownership

alt: Animation of recursive Shift-click respecting red latched child folders
caption: Recursive expansion changes unlocked descendants but preserves the intended expansion of red latched children.
capture_instructions: Record a parent folder with at least three nested child folders, one red-open and one red-closed. Shift-click the unlocked parent to collapse and expand; show the red children retaining their protected logical states.
heading: Shift-click expands or collapses a branch

alt: Flowchart of recursive expansion skipping children with saved latch states
caption: Recursive actions follow the real Outliner tree and protect descendants that already have expansion latches.
capture_instructions: Draw FRegistry HandleRecursiveExpanderClick walking the live tree, checking ULatchSubsystem expansion state, applying changes only to unlocked descendants and requesting reconciliation afterward.
heading: Native hierarchy interaction

alt: Animation of Alt-clicking one selected parent to latch several selected parents
caption: A selected parent determines the batch's expansion-latch intent while childless selected rows are ignored.
capture_instructions: Record three selected folders with children plus one selected leaf Actor. Alt-click the expansion triangle on one selected folder, show red states applied to eligible parents and the leaf unchanged, then Alt-click again to remove the latches.
heading: Expansion batch

alt: Animation of batch pin toggling on a mixed Outliner selection
caption: A Keep Visible batch enables all eligible pins when any are unpinned, and disables them when all are pinned.
capture_instructions: Select three Actors with only one white pin active. Click the pin of a selected row to make all white, then click again to clear all pins. Keep selection highlighting and the pin states clearly visible.
heading: Keep Visible batch

alt: Diagram showing clicked-row membership determining batch action scope
caption: Latch applies direct-control gestures to the active selection only when the clicked row is itself selected.
capture_instructions: Draw two paths: clicked row belongs to the selected item IDs → batch eligible items, and clicked row is not selected → only clicked item. Annotate parent-only latch and Actor/Folder pin eligibility.
heading: Target resolution

caption: The Latch submenu exposes explicit expansion, pin, branch-clearing and suspension commands.
